full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of a lymph node showing a prominent granulomatous lesion. The histological section displays a central area of caseous necrosis surrounded by epithelioid macrophages, lymphocytes, and multinucleated giant cells. These features are characteristic of a necrotizing granuloma. The findings are most consistent with tuberculosis or a similar granulomatous infection.

random.description: This is a micrograph of lung tissue showing characteristic granulomatous inflammation. The image reveals central caseous necrosis surrounded by epithelioid macrophages, lymphocytes, and multinucleated giant cells. These histological findings are classic features of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection, commonly known as tuberculosis.
